description: This file defines a template class QueueType within the Thunder::Core namespace, implementing a thread-safe producer-consumer queue with various control methods such as Post, Remove, Insert, Extract, Enable, Disable, and Flush. It manages internal state with a StateTrigger and uses locking mechanisms for concurrency control.

classes.name: QueueType
classes.description: A thread-safe, producer-consumer queue template class with state management and synchronization features.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific entry from the queue if present.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds an entry to the queue if not disabled.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Attempts to insert an entry into the queue, waiting up to a specified time if the queue is limited.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the first entry from the queue, waiting up to a specified time if empty.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, preventing further operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all entries from the queue; only allowed when disabled.

methods.name: FreeSlot
methods.description: Waits until a slot is available in the queue.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: IsFull
methods.description: Checks if the queue has reached its maximum capacity.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the queue.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Applies a provided action to each entry in the queue.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific entry exists in the queue.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the queue for thread-safe operations.
